title: How to Enable the Recurring Events | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Enable the Recurring Events Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000050725 Overview Want to publish events that repeat daily or weekly? A recurring event is any event that occurs more than once, according to a specified time interval, such as meetings, courses and more. The Auto-Recurring Events add-on eliminates the need to manually repost events that repeat – simply set how often the event should repeat and the website will automatically do the rest, creating recurring events! How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Auto-Recurring Events Add-On Enabling Recurring Events The events form will add these new fields for the events feature: Recurring Event Options Repeat Every Day Repeat Every 7 Days (Weekly) Repeat Every 14 Days (every 2 weeks) Repeat Every 21 Days (every 3 weeks) Repeat every 28 Days (every 4 weeks) Disable Recurring Events If this add-on is not required in the directory, please follow these steps to turn off for the directory members: 1. Go to Content - Edit Post Settings 2. Search for the default or any other event related feature and click Edit: 3. Scroll down in the General Settings and expand the Additional Settings: 4. Enable or disable this feature: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
